Attorney General James Secures Nearly $6 Million From Crypto: problems: Flag 'Bonus for recruiting': the cited quote is about AWS Mining, the earlier scheme with 15 to 20 percent monthly returns, not the NovaTech-style pitch shown (2 to 4 percent weekly, registered broker). The claim itself is true for NovaTech, but the evidence should use the NovaTech sentence ('...promoted recruitment bonuses...') so the quote matches the scheme on screen. (rewrite 1 of 2)

Attorney General James Secures Nearly $6 Million From Crypto: problems: safeMove: the label 'Tell the Attorney General' tells viewers to report to the AG, but the source gives no reporting instruction, phone number, or channel. The quote only says the office 'will always stand up for New Yorkers who have been targeted'. Viewers get an action with no way to take it. (rewrite 2 of 2)

Attorney General James Secures Nearly $6 Million From Crypto: problems: safeMove label 'Keep your crypto' is advice the source never gives. The source only reports that investors could not withdraw when NovaTech collapsed; it offers no protective guidance.

Crypto Scams are Booming: Attorney General Bonta Clocks Cryp: problems: The title 'A friend's crypto money tip in your DMs is a scam' states as a blanket fact that any friend's crypto tip is a scam. The source only says a friend's sudden 'great investment opportunity' message may mean the account was hacked, and advises checking. The scam verdict for this message rests on the guaranteed returns and the required crypto payment, not on the fact that it came from a friend. Tie the title to those red flags, or soften it (for example, 'could be a scam'). (rewrite 1 of 2)
